walkthrough: Find the pressure at the plate depth from the given force and area: $p = F/A$.
State the hydrostatic pressure rule for depth $h$ in liquid density $\rho$: $p = \rho g h$.
Rearrange for depth: $h = p/(\rho g) = F/(A \rho g)$.
Substitute $\rho = 930 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ and $g = 9.81 \text{ m s}^{-2}$: $h \approx 8060/(930 \times 9.81) \approx 8060/9123 \approx 0.88 \text{ m}$ with unit $\text{m}$.
